changing the key contract, which is a version bump and not an edit
every conversation with a segment that has crossed a threshold

provider_block.job: one operating standard across many sites

with_us.note: No hosted step. The production check runs over the sites' own key contract and evidence.

checks.title: The key contract is written down and versioned
Segments can add fields and cannot rename or fork keys
Segment membership comes from an access group
Drift is detected on a schedule, covering all four kinds
One definition of every measure, computed once
The report publishes on schedule regardless of the numbers
Each segment sees its own report
A threshold routes to a named person
A new segment's gates are live before its first real record
